scope: Phase 2 residual-robust depth control proposal, not geometric reliability. This step inspects sources and hashes only.
hypothesis: Does one fixed Cauchy-shaped residual penalty offer evidence beyond both existing L1 and a fixed weaker-L1 control, exceeding observed bookend variability?
evidence_boundary: Post-D1/D2 development proposal on already-known leaves; no independent final-test or novelty claims. Distance/cross-view score routes remain stopped.

references.title: SciPy least_squares: robust loss shapes and scale
references.used_for: Standard log(1+z) Cauchy shape and caution about optimization; no SciPy runtime dependency. Our peak-gradient normalization is separately derived, not a default SciPy setting.

input_contract.anchors: Four anchor files are provenance-audit inputs, not loaded as new training targets. Use original full-data aligned prior caches, never D1/D2 held-out fits or scores.
input_contract.test_policy: No test asset opened in this planning step. Before a separately approved training pilot, independently freeze evaluator-only four test RGBs and cameras.json hashes. Never give their paths/metrics to the trainer.

frozen_training_protocol.render_mode: RGB+ED for all four processes, including pre-activation updates
frozen_training_protocol.strategy: Unchanged gsplat DefaultStrategy, optimizers, densification and full 30k schedules; no camera/appearance/exposure changes
frozen_training_protocol.source_preflight: Explicit clean pinned gsplat source directory and future modified local source hashes required before execution. Source path verification is pending; planning is not an execution-ready environment audit.

residual_and_reduction.valid: Same cached positive/border mask, detached alpha>=0.5, finite ED and detached ED>1e-6; no residual-dependent pixel exclusion.
residual_and_reduction.reduction: mean over currently valid pixels, denominator=count_valid.clamp_min(1); empty mask returns finite zero loss and zero gradient
residual_and_reduction.aggregation: Average rho(r) before multiplying lambda; no division by sum of robust influence factors
residual_and_reduction.note: Per-trajectory alpha/masks may later differ because optimization differs; report valid counts rather than forcing shared post-hoc masks.

candidate_loss.name: Cauchy shape, explicitly normalized to maximum residual-gradient magnitude one
candidate_loss.scale_meaning: 10% of the per-image training-anchor inverse-Z median; not 10% relative error at each pixel
candidate_loss.large_residual_behavior: Influence tends to zero as abs(r) grows; nonconvex outside abs(r)>c
candidate_loss.selection_policy: One declared scale and formula, no c/lambda sweep. Declared after historical development results; not selected from new test metrics or fitted to dense truth.
candidate_loss.caution: Peak-gradient normalization does not match average objective/gradient strength to L1; weak-L1 control is necessary and still not an exact strength match.

future_pilot_order.role: Fixed half-strength scalar control; explicitly new arm, does not revise old uniform settings
Bookend repeat: same seed/code/inputs, retain both A models

matching.execution: Sequential same-boot processes; record boot ID/driver/source/input hashes before and after each. Any change stops and preserves attempts.
matching.initialization: All four identical initial parameter SHA256 and view-order hashes; old runs are historical context only, never replace fresh controls.
matching.preactivation: For steps <1000 use the original L1 computation path in all arms, weight zero; dispatch Cauchy only after activation. Diagnostics must not consume RNG.
matching.legacy: Default L1 value/gradient/mask/reduction and historical fern entry must remain identical; protect frozen source copies and all old runs.

future_logging.cadence: Existing 1000-update records plus first active update 1001; no new scoring/selection feedback
quantities: raw normalized L1 residual mean in every arm
lambda and fixed c where applicable
lambda-weighted mean/sum absolute d(depth objective)/d(ED), including valid-count, normalizer and ED^-2 factors
Gaussian count, wall/perf/CUDA clocks, allocated/reserved/full-card sampled memory
future_logging.semantic_guard: Do not relabel Cauchy objective as depth_normalized_l1. Influence diagnostics never form a confidence map, change masks, renormalize weights, tune c or choose checkpoints.

cpu_implementation_gate: Keep original L1 path/default exactly: forward, expected-Z derivative, mask, empty-mask behavior and normalization
Check analytic Cauchy value/gradient against autograd and finite differences on positive/negative/zero and small/large residuals, including z-chain rule; no GPU needed
Verify nonnegative/even objective, zero at zero, derivative bound one and decay at large residuals; use stable algebra without silent clipping or epsilon changes
All three loss profiles share eligibility and valid-count denominator on identical fixtures; weaker L1 gradients exactly half of full L1
No residual-based selection, all-empty finite zero, no invalid ED reciprocals leaking NaN gradients
CLI rejects unknown loss/invalid c/invalid lambda or absent priors before CUDA; explicit directories and no overwrite
Frozen original function/source snapshot parity, backward-compatible CLI, metadata fields truthful; no test/metric/score asset loading or network calls

release_gates.now: Proposal review only. No loss implementation, autograd tests, GPU initialization, rendering, training or new evaluation in this step.
release_gates.next_recommended: Separately authorize minimal loss plumbing and CPU value/gradient/isolation checks only. It does not release GPU preflight or the four runs.
release_gates.before_any_training: Review actual implementation/test results; freeze future sources/upstream/evaluator assets/weights and exact commands; obtain separate approval for all four 30k runs and zero-update GPU preflight.
release_gates.failure: Preserve failed checks and attempts; investigate first. No automatic rerun, coefficient/scale sweep, shortening/resizing/precision changes or use of old controls to complete matrix.

evaluation_after_all_four_complete.process: Separate unchanged evaluator; no test renders/metrics between runs or during model selection. Use same four existing development test GTs, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS-Alex, train/test reports and all per-view regressions.
evaluation_after_all_four_complete.weights: Reuse verified AlexNet SHA256 7be5be791159472b1fbf3c69796f7cb30dca7ad8466c2df70058c37116cdee02; no automatic downloads
evaluation_after_all_four_complete.qualitative: Full fixed test-view RGB/GT/error comparison plus existing depth/3D outputs; no favorable crops/view selection. No new geometry accuracy claim without GT.
evaluation_after_all_four_complete.bookend_range: For each scene-mean metric, R=abs(A1-A2); two repeats give a descriptive observed range, not a variance estimate or confidence interval.
evaluation_after_all_four_complete.pilot_direction_gate: Transform metrics to higher-is-better (PSNR, SSIM, -LPIPS). For each metric m, C_m-max(A1_m,A2_m,B_m) must be strictly greater than abs(A1_m-A2_m). All three metrics must satisfy this predeclared rule. Always report all pairwise/per-view differences and actual magnitudes.
evaluation_after_all_four_complete.if_fail: No favorable pilot evidence by this rule. Stop this scoped candidate, or label bookend/implementation problems unresolved; no automatic extra seeds/scenes or tuning.
evaluation_after_all_four_complete.if_pass: Only recommend separately reviewing a same-protocol multi-seed extension; no stable-performance, significance, causal shape benefit, Phase 3 release or final-test claim. One half-L1 scalar is not exhaustive strength matching.

resources.future_GPU: Local 12 GB budget; fastest supported measured configuration with headroom; no paid/cloud resources. Keep frozen 504x378/batch1/float32 and optimizer settings.
resources.estimate_basis: Historical leaves44 complete controls were 640.725 to 757.181 seconds each. Four times this range is an estimate, not a Cauchy measurement; preflight/evaluation/retries excluded.
resources.memory_basis: Historical complete controls sampled full-card peaks <=4310 MiB; includes desktop differences, not a guarantee for new loss. Measure actual allocated/reserved/full-card memory.

prohibited_now: Loss implementation or actual CPU autograd test
Reliability weights, D1/D2 score reuse, new scenes, new data/prior generation or hyperparameter search
Downloads, staging, new commits or pushes of planning changes
